_about: External datasets, benchmark code and models used by the paper. None is redistributed here. tools/check_inputs.py verifies the local copies against this file; tools/fetch_tau2.sh reads the tau2-bench commit from it.

tau2-bench-telecom.what: telecom domain of tau2-bench in solo mode (agent-only, no simulated user); training pool = all telecom_full tasks outside the official test split (2,214 initial states), test = the official 40-task test split

dapo-math-integer.what: integer-answer problems of DAPO-Math-17k as packaged by rStar2-Agent (train.jsonl, 14,116 problems); test = 300 problems drawn with seed 0 by xper/mathenv.py, training = the other 13,816
dapo-math-integer.obtain: download train.jsonl from the rStar2-Agent release into data/external/math/

toolace.used_for: building the weak telecom start (one epoch of generic function-calling SFT on Qwen3-8B-Base)
toolace.what: ToolACE function-calling conversations (11,300); scripts/prep_common_sft.py keeps 10,216 after filtering against tau2 tool names
toolace.obtain: download the ToolACE data file into data/external/toolace.json

Qwen3-8B-Base.role: weak target after delimiter initialization (scripts/prep_init.py); telecom adds the ToolACE SFT

Qwen3-4B-Base.role: second target of the permutation control (Table 8)

models._note: Expected under $XPER_HOME/models/hf/<name>. index_sha256 is the SHA-256 of model.safetensors.index.json in the copy the experiments used.
